text: Northwestern Mutual is a mutual insurance company owned by its policyowners, with no publicly traded stock and no state shareholder; the sponsorship money comes from a policyowner-owned mutual, not from public investor capital.

source.name: Northwestern Mutual (via PR Newswire): Northwestern Mutual Announces Historic $9.2 Billion Dividend Payout in 2026
source.quote: As a proud mutual company, we're committed to sharing our success in the form of dividends with our policyowners at such an extraordinary scale.
